g.text: Roll a card back if its move fails
Drag and drop cards between columns
Users should be able to move a card to another column by dragging it. The
card moves straight away and we save in the background.
Card follows the pointer while dragging
Dashed slot shows where it will land
If saving fails, card moves back and an error toast shows
dnd-kit supports dragging with the keyboard out of the box. Worth using
instead of the browser's built-in drag API.
